camel_example: aliyun devops POST /organization/60ee8a814690c27532d412f8/workitems/updateWorkitemField --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"workitemIdentifier":"9144ef6b72d8exxxxx9e61a4d0","updateWorkitemPropertyRequest":[{"fieldIdentifier":"tag","fieldValue":"个人属性"}]}
description_zh: 更新工作项字段，可以支持批量更新多个字段
name: UpdateWorkitemField

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the work item. This is the same as `workitemId`
parameters.help_zh: 工作项id，同workitemId，工作项唯一标识
parameters.name: workitem_identifier

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the work item field to update. You can obtain this ID by calling the API to retrieve all work item fields
element_fields.help_zh: 需要更新的工作项字段id，可以从获取工作项所有字段接口获取相应的数据
element_fields.name: field_identifier

element_fields.help_en: The new value for the field. Note the following: (1) For a user type field, provide the `aliyunPK`. (2) For a field with option values, provide the ID of the selected option. (3) For multiple values, provide a single, comma-separated string
element_fields.help_zh: 需要更新字段的属性值 (注：1.如果是人员类型的值必须要填写aliyunPK。2.如果是含有待选值的字段，填写相应的待选值的id。 3.如果多个值，需要用" , "进行分割，拼接成一个字符串
element_fields.name: field_value

parameters.help_en: A list of work item properties to update
parameters.help_zh: 更新工作项属性请求，数组形式
parameters.name: update_workitem_property_request
